chapters: The word of Havayah that came to Michah the Morashiti in the days of Yotam, Achaz, and Chizkiyahu, the kings of Yehudah, which he prophesied concerning Shomron and Yerushalayim.
Hear, all you peoples; hearken, O land and the fullness thereof, and let Havayah Elokim be a witness against you; Havayah from His Holy Temple.
For behold, Havayah comes forth from His place, and He shall descend and tread upon the high places of the earth.
And the mountains shall melt under Him, and the valleys shall split — as wax before fire, as water poured down a steep place.

All this is because of the transgression of Yackov, and because of the sins of the house of Yisroel. Who is the cause of the transgression of Yackov? Is it not Shomron? And who is the cause of the high places of Yehudah? Is it not Yerushalayim?
And I will make Shomron into a heap in the field, into a place for planting vineyards; and I will cast its stones down into the valley, and its foundations I will uncover.

And all its graven images shall be crushed, and all its hires shall be burnt with fire, and all its idols I will lay waste; for from the hire of a harlot it gathered, and to the hire of a harlot shall they return.
Concerning this I will lament and wail; I will go mad and be naked; I will make a wailing as jackals, and mourning as ostriches.
For she is mortally ill from her wounds, for it has come up to Yehudah; it has reached the gate of My people up to Yerushalayim.
Do not declare it in Gat, do not weep; in the houses of Afrah, wallow in the dust.

Pass along your way, you inhabitant of Shafir, with your private parts exposed; the inhabitants of Tzaanan did not go forth; the lamentation caused by drawing the houses one to the other shall take its stand from you.
For the one dwelling in disobedience hoped for good, but evil descended from Havayah to the gate of Yerushalayim.
Hitch the chariot to the swift steeds, you inhabitant of Lachish; it is the beginning of sin for the daughter of Tziyon, for in you were found the transgressions of Yisroel.
Since you give expulsions to the dynasty that gave you the possession of Gat, the houses of Achziv shall be a dried up spring for the kings of Yisroel.
I will yet bring the possessor to you, O inhabitant of Mareishah; up to Adulam shall the glory of Yisroel come.
Make your head bald and crop your hair for the children of your delight; widen your bald spot to be like an eagle — for they have been exiled from you.
Woe to those who plot iniquity and work evil in their beds; when the morning becomes light they perform it, for their hand has the power.
And they covet fields, and they rob; and houses, and they take; and they oppress a man and his house, and a man and his heritage.
Therefore, so Havayah said: Behold! I plot evil against this family, from which you shall not remove your necks, nor shall you walk erect, for it is a time of evil.

On that day he shall take up a parable against you, and he shall lament, "A lamentation has come about"; and he shall say, "They have robbed us! He changes the portion of my people! How will He turn to me to return our fields, which he divides?"
Therefore, you shall not have anyone who casts a line by lot in the congregation of Havayah.
"Preach not, those who preach; they shall not preach to these; then they shall not take shame."
Is that what is said by the house of Yackov? Has Havayah's patience grown short? Are these His deeds? Do my words not benefit the one who goes straight?
And the matter for which My people causes Me to rise as an enemy, because of the garment and the mantle that you strip from those who pass by confidently, who return from the war.
The wives of My people you drive away from the house of her delights, from her infants — you take away My glory forever.
Arise and go, for this is not the tranquility; in order to contaminate it, it forms bands, and the band is clarified.
If a man walking in wind and falsehood lies, "I will preach to you of wine and strong drink," he shall be a preacher for this people.
I will surely assemble, O Yackov, all of you; I will surely gather the remnant of Yisroel; together I will make them as sheep in a fold, as a flock within its stall shall they stir with people.
The breaker has gone up before them; they broke and passed through a gate and went out through it; and their king passed before them, and Havayah was at their head.
And I said: Hearken now, you heads of Yackov and officers of the house of Yisroel! Is it not incumbent upon you to know the judgment?
Those who hate good and love evil — who rob their skin from upon them and their flesh from upon their bones,
and who ate the flesh of My people and flayed their skin from upon them, and opened their bones and broke them, as in a pot, and like meat within a cauldron
then they shall cry out to Havayah, but He shall not respond to them; and He shall hide His countenance from them at that time, as they wrought evil with their works.
So Havayah said concerning the prophets who mislead my people, who bite with their teeth and herald peace, but concerning whomever does not give into their mouth, they prepare war.
Therefore, it shall be night for you because of the vision, and it shall be dark for you because of the divination, and the sun shall set on the prophets, and the day shall be darkened about them.
And the seers shall be ashamed, and the diviners shall be disgraced, and they shall all cover their upper lips, for it is not a statement of Elokim.
But I am truly full of strength from the spirit of Havayah and justice and might, to tell Yackov his transgression and Yisroel his sin.
Hearken now to this, you heads of the house of Yackov and you rulers of the house of Yisroel, who condemn justice and pervert all that is straight.
Each one builds Tziyon with blood and Yerushalayim with injustice.
Its heads judge for bribes, and its priests teach for a price; and its prophets divine for money, and they rely on Havayah, saying, "Is not Havayah in our midst? No evil shall befall us."
Therefore, because of you, Tziyon shall be plowed as a field; Yerushalayim shall become heaps, and the Temple Mount like the high places of a forest.

And it shall be at the end of the days, that the mountain of Havayah's house shall be firmly established at the top of the mountains, and it shall be raised above the hills, and peoples shall stream upon it.

And many nations shall go, and they shall say, "Come, let us go up to Havayah's mount and to the house of the Elokim of Yackov, and let Him teach us of His ways, and we will go in His paths," for out of Tziyon shall the Torah come forth, and the word of Havayah from Yerushalayim.

And he shall judge between many peoples and reprove mighty nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks; nations shall not lift the sword against nation; neither shall they learn war anymore.
And they shall dwell each man under his vine and under his fig tree, and no one shall make them move, for the mouth of Havayah of Hosts has spoken.
For all peoples shall go, each one in the name of his deity, but we will go in the name of Havayah, our Elokim, forever and ever.
On that day, Havayah says: I will heal the limping one, and the lost one I will gather, and those whom I harmed.
And I will make the limping one into a remnant, and the scattered one into a mighty nation, and Havayah shall reign over them on Mount Tziyon from now and forever.
And you — tower of the flock, the tower of the daughter of Tziyon — to you it shall come; yea, the former kingdom shall come to the daughter of Yerushalayim.
Now, why do you seek friends? Is the King not among you? Has your Counsellor perished, that pangs have seized you like a woman in confinement?

Be in pain and kneel, O daughter of Tziyon, like a woman in confinement, for now you shall go forth from the city; and you shall dwell in the field, and you shall come up to Bavel; there you shall be saved; there Havayah shall redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
And now, many nations shall gather upon you who say, "Let her be guilty, and our eyes shall gaze on Tziyon."
But they did not know the thoughts of Havayah; neither did they understand His counsel, for He gathered them as sheaves to a threshing floor.

Arise and thresh, O daughter of Tziyon, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hooves copper; and you shall crush many nations, and you shall devote their plunder to Havayah, and their wealth to Havayah of all the earth.
Now you shall gather yourself in troops, O daughter of troops; he has laid seige to us. With a rod they strike the judges of Yisroel on the cheek.
And you, Beis Lechem Efratah — you should have been the lowest of the clans of Yehudah — from you he shall emerge for Me, to be a ruler over Yisroel; and his origin is from of old, from days of yore.
Therefore, He shall deliver them until the time a woman in confinement gives birth. And the rest of his brothers shall return upon the children of Yisroel.
And he shall stand and lead with the might of Havayah, with the pride of Havayah, his Elokim: and they shall return, for now he shall become great to the ends of the earth.
And this shall be peace. Should Ashur come into our land, and should they tread upon our palaces, we will appoint over them seven shepherds and eight princes of men.
And they shall break the land of Ashur with the sword, and the land of Nimrod at its gates; and he shall save us from Ashur, who comes into our land, and who treads in our border.
And the remnant of Yackov shall be in the midst of many peoples — like dew sent by Havayah, like torrents of rain upon vegetation that does not hope for any man and does not wait for the sons of men.

And the remnant of Yackov shall be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples — like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep, which, if it passes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and no one can save anything.
Your hand shall be raised above your oppressors, and all your enemies shall be destroyed.
And it shall come to pass on that day, Havayah says, that I will cut your horses out of your midst, and I will destroy your chariots.
And I will destroy the cities of your land, and I will break down all your fortresses.
And I will destroy sorcery from your hand, and you will have no soothsayers.
And I will destroy your graven images and your monuments from your midst, and you shall no longer prostrate yourself to your handiwork.
And I will uproot your asherim from your midst, and I will destroy your enemies.
And in anger and fury I will execute vengeance upon the nations who have paid no heed.
Hear now what Havayah says; Rise; contend with the mountains, and may the hills hear My voice.
Hear ye, O mountains, the controversy of Havayah; and you mighty ones, the foundations of the earth; for Havayah has a controversy with His people, and with Yisroel He shall contend.
O My people, what have I done, and how have I wearied you? Testify against Me.
For I brought you up out of the land of Mitzrayim and redeemed you from the house of slavery, and I sent before you Moshe, Aharon, and Miriam.
My people, remember now what Balak king of Moav planned, and what Bilam the son of Beor answered him. From Shittim to Gilgal, may you recognize the righteous deeds of Havayah.
With what shall I come before Havayah, bow before Elyon Elokim? Shall I come before Him with burnt offerings, with yearling calves?
Will Havayah be pleased with thousands of rams, with myriad streams of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
He has told you, O man, what is good, and what Havayah demands of you; but to do justice, to love loving-kindness, and to walk discreetly with your Elokim.
The voice of Havayah calls out to the city, and the wisdom of the Torah, the one who sees Your name; hearken to the staff and Who appointed it.
Does the house of the wicked last long, or do the treasures of wickedness? And an ephah of leanness is condemned.
Will I merit with scales of wickedness or with a bag of deceitful weights?
For the wealthy thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof speak lies, and their tongue is guile in their mouth.
Therefore I, too, will smite you with sore wounds and make you desolate because of your sins.
You shall eat and not be sated, and it shall bend you over in your innards; and you shall overtake, but you shall not rescue, and those whom you rescue I will deliver to the sword.
You shall sow, but you shall not reap; you shall tread the olives, but you shall not anoint yourself with oil; and the must; but you shall not drink wine.

And the statutes of Omri shall be observed, and every deed of the house of Achav; and you shall walk in their counsels, in order that I make you an astonishment, and its inhabitants a hissing; and the disgrace of My people you shall bear.
Woe is to me, for I am as the last of the figs, like the gleanings of the vintage; there is no cluster to eat; the first ripe fig my soul desires.
The pious have perished from the land, and there is no upright among men; they all lurk for blood; each one hunts his brother with a net.

In return for the evil of their hands, do they expect that He will benefit them? The prince asks, and the judge is in the payment, and the great man speaks what is in his heart — and they weave the web.
The best of them is like a brier, the most upright, worse than a thorn hedge. The day to which you look forward — your visitation — shall come; now will be their perplexity.
Believe not a friend; trust not a prince; from she who lies in your bosom guard the openings of your mouth.
For a son disgraces his father; a daughter rises up against her mother; a daughter — in-law, against her mother — in-law; a man's enemies are the members of his household.
But I will hope in Havayah; I will wait for the Elokim of my salvation; my Elokim shall hearken to me.
Rejoice not against me, my enemy; although I have fallen, I will rise; although I will sit in darkness, Havayah is a light to me.
I will bear the fury of Havayah — for I have sinned against Him — until He pleads my cause and executes justice for me. He shall take me out into the light; I will see His righteousness.
And my enemy shall see, and shame shall cover her who says to me, "Where is Havayah your Elokim?" My eyes shall gaze upon her: now she shall become trodden as the mire of the streets.
"The day to build your walls — that day — its time is way off."
It is a day, and he shall come up to you: those from Ashur and the fortified cities, and from the fortress up to the river and the sea from the west, and the dwellers of the mountain.
And the land shall become desolate together with its inhabitants because of the fruit of their deeds.
Lead Your people with Your rod — the flock of Your inheritance who dwell alone, a forest in the midst of a fruitful field — and they shall graze in Bashan and Gilad as in days of yore.
As in the days of your exodus from the land of Mitzrayim, I will show him wonders.
Nations shall see and be ashamed of all their might — they shall place a hand upon their mouth; their ears shall become deaf.
They shall lick the dust as a snake, as those who crawl on the earth. They shall quake from their imprisonment; they shall fear Havayah, our Elokim, and they shall fear you.
Who is a Elokim like You, Who forgives iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His heritage? He does not maintain His anger forever, for He desires loving-kindness.
He shall return and grant us compassion; He shall hide our iniquities, and You shall cast into the depths of the sea all their sins.
You shall give the truth of Yackov, the loving-kindness of Avraham, which You swore to our forefathers from days of yore.
